content:
🏠 𝗔 𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘁𝗹𝗲 𝗣𝗚 𝗵𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 ❤️

Last year, for my CA Foundation exams, I stayed in a PG for around 6 months. To be honest, I didn't really make any such friends or connections there.

This time, I went to the same place for CA Intermediate, 𝗧𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗜’𝗱 𝘀𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗼𝗻𝗹𝘆 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝟮𝟬–𝟮𝟱 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀.

I was mostly busy with studies, so I didn't get much time to talk or interact. But somehow, I made some really sweet connections —
 𝗺𝘆 𝗿𝗼𝗼𝗺𝗺𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗮 𝗗𝗶𝗱𝗶 f𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲 wala 𝗿𝗼𝗼𝗺, 𝘄𝗵𝗼 𝘄𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝗮 𝗳𝗲𝘄 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀 𝗼𝗹𝗱𝗲𝗿 𝘁o 𝗺𝗲.

She would always say, “Ho jayega, you will do it.”
And whenever I get low , 𝗜 𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝗵𝘂𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗺 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗰𝗿𝘆 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗹𝗮𝗶𝗻 𝗮𝗻𝘆𝘁𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗴. 🥹❤️

After my exams, when I left, I thought that would probably be the end.

But then came the video calls. 🤌
 We started talking more, sharing PG incidents and laughing about them.

It made me realise — I have friends I've known for 10–15 years, but yet not comfortable with them !! 

𝗠𝗮𝘆𝗯𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗻𝗴𝘁𝗵 𝗼𝗳 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗱𝗼𝗲𝘀𝗻’𝘁 𝗮𝗹𝘄𝗮𝘆𝘀 𝗱𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝗶𝘁𝘀 𝗱𝗲𝗽𝘁𝗵. 𝗦𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲𝘀, 𝗮 𝗳𝗲𝘄 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀 𝗰𝗮𝗻 𝗰𝗿𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗺𝗲𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗶𝗲𝘀 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗺𝘂𝗰𝗵 𝗹𝗼𝗻𝗴𝗲𝗿. 🌻

And I really hope I stay connected with my PG mates for a longer time. ❤️

One of my favourite little memories from my CA journey. 🥹
